FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE BADDEGAMA PRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONSORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of return member of Baddegama Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of being ceased to be a member of the party;

And whereas the Secretary of the Sarvajana Balaya, the recognized political party to which Amal Indika Udawaththa the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(l) of the aforesaid Ordinance, to decide upon returned member of Baddegama Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party and is not disqualified under Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared elected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days;
And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision to nominate Dewa Suranga Prema Chandana to fill such vacancy;

Therefore I, Wewelwala Hewage Ravindra Wijaya Kumara, Returning Officer of the Baddegama Pradeshiya Sabha, acting in terms of Section 66A(l) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Dewa Suranga Prema Chandana was elected as the member of the Baddegama Pradeshiya Sabha. W. H. R. Wijaya Kumara, Returning Officer, Baddegama Pradeshiya Sabha. District Elections Office,Galle,23rd of February, 2026.
PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.
